about: Street words for the voice, the on-screen text and the post text (the owner, 2026-10-06: films should sound like the street, mild Georgian folk insults are fine and get shared; the heaviest make the brand ugly). tools/ci/streetwords.mjs reads this file (check.mjs, build-index, prompt.mjs --record and the brief, filmlint); a missing or broken file stops them (fail closed). "allowed": mild folk words a film may use, 1 to 3 per film ("perFilm"), only in a persona ("me") line or a made-up character's line, never put in a real person's mouth (no invented quote, no vulgar word about a named person or brand: "realNames"), never at the viewer, never about a woman as ბოზი ("notAtWoman"), never next to a mother insult ("mother"), never in the "zones" (the cover, the meta bar, the EndCard tagline and note, the post and its tags). A word matches with its Georgian case endings (ბოზს, ჩუჩელავ, უმაქნისოო), never inside another word (სირია, ვირუსი, ტრაქტორი pass). "plain": allowed words that also have an everyday meaning (cattle, a rat, a donkey, a pig, rubbish, lazy): they count only in an insult frame ("frame": „შე ...“, „... ხარ“, „... ხარო“, „მეძახის“). "banned": never, in any form, anywhere a viewer hears or reads (a word that STARTS with one of these stems; ordinary words that merely contain the letters pass), and "bannedRe" the patterns a stem cannot say. Group slurs (orientation, ethnicity, religion, a disability used as an insult), mother insults and sexual content are out whatever the list says. Russian slang stays out (CLAUDE.md rule 4, no Russianisms: ლოხი, ლოშარა, ჩმო, ფუფლო, ფრაერი were left off on purpose; ჩუჩელა is on the list because the owner named it). Not in every film (the owner: „აქა-იქა“): "frequency" (never two films in a row, at most one film in three, page-wide, by film number) and "rotation" (a word the last street film said is not said again by the next one). A free film (the free idea) says only the street words he typed. "refrain": the aura openings' fixed words (H21 grindset, H22 glow-up), left out of the opening freshness rules.

bannedRe.why: sexual vulgarity (the root of the mother insults)
a disability used as an insult

frequency.why: the owner, 2026-10-06: here and there, where the idea and opening suit it; 2026-10-07: the aura opening moved from the crazy stories to car knowledge ("a person who solves a problem and explains it to people"), sometimes, not every film; an aura opening says a street word, the others only where a made-up line fits; never two films in a row, at most one in three

rotation: a word the newest film with street words said is not said again by the next one
